== Summary ==
Identified: none. The player in a Welsh-dragon shirt, glasses, and a blond beard is the same man as the tan-vest teammate in [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 3.jpg]] (already a [[Justin Branch]] still; this teammate is unlabeled there) and is not bald [[Kevin Jaap]]. The player in glasses and a black shirt is the same man as [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 19.jpg]] (already a [[Chris Menzel]] still; this teammate is unlabeled there). Faces unlabeled.
The [[2022 European Championship]] weekend in Bochum, Germany, from the "Team Wales Photo Log" thread.

* '''Event:''' [[2022 European Championship]]
* '''Date posted:''' 2022-09-13
* '''Identification:''' the people are not named in the post.
